newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SCHOOL CHILDREN RING DEATH KNELL FOR JUVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHOOL CHILDREN RING DEATH KNELL FOR JUVE.

text.p: As Italy mourned the defeat of Juventus in the European Cup final, children in Turin rang the club's death knell in a satirical funeral rite on Thursday.

"Suddenly, in the final of the Champions League in Munich against Borussia Dortmund, after immense suffering, the ex-European champions Juventus was taken away from its loving fans," the mock order of service read.
On the paper was a picture of Juventus coach Marcello Lippi.

With most of Italy really grieving after Juventus lost their European crown in a 3-1 defeat to the German club on Wednesday, there was little doubt who was behind the prank -- fans of city rivals Torino.
